sources.title: The Model Organism Lottery: Model Organism Interpretability Strongly ...
sources.snippet: Abstract Model organisms (MOs) — language models trained to exhibit undesired or unnatural behaviours — are frequently used as testbeds for evaluating white-box interpretability techniques. Current MOs are typically constructed via post-hoc supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on behavioural transcripts or synthetic documents.
